scripts.build: python3 build.py && node minify.js && python3 build_pack.py packs/english-pronouns.json english && node minify.js deploy/english.html deploy/english.min.html && python3 build_pack.py packs/math-fractions.json fractions && node minify.js deploy/fractions.html deploy/fractions.min.html && python3 build_packpage.py && node minify.js deploy/pack.html deploy/pack.min.html && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('scan.html','deploy/scan.html')"
